El Terricola: El Terricola carries the romantic Mexican-music side of the label, including the 2022 Nastyboy Records single Porque Yo Te Amo.
Jay Roxxx: Jay Roxxx's 2021 album PRINCESA moves between solo songs and MC Magic collaborations, opening a newer chapter in the label catalogue.
MC Magic: MC Magic founded Nastyboy Records to release music from his home studio and create a path for a community he felt the industry had ignored.
Nastyboy Klick: Nastyboy Klick preserves the early group chapter of the catalogue, with albums including Tha First Chapter and Tha Second Coming.
NB Ridaz: NB Ridaz carries the label's melodic group sound through albums including Invasion and NB Ridaz.com.
